source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Units leave a **TRANSPORT** model in two ways:

- During their own Movement phase, each one of the active player's embarked units may make a **[Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/disembark-move)** (rule 18.04).
- If the **TRANSPORT** model is **destroyed**, each unit inside it is required to make an **[Emergency Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/emergency-disembark-move)** (rule 18.05), resolved by the active player before the model is removed.

voluntary.units: the active player's units embarked within a Transport model

forced.timing: before the Transport model is removed from the battlefield

referenceAdditions.topic: the two cross-references read as rule codes (18.04, 18.05) where print points the reader elsewhere on the spread
